Do not name specific real companies, real plan names, or real places beyond a generic reference to living in Maricopa County, Arizona.

response.backstory: Dana Whitlock is 67 and lives on a limited fixed income in Maricopa County, Arizona, with Medicaid assistance alongside Medicare. Dana carefully tracks premiums, copayments, prescription costs, and unexpected bills, often comparing coverage with the employer-sponsored insurance remembered from working years. Day to day, Dana budgets for household essentials, medical appointments, and medications, and is willing to switch plans when the savings are meaningful. A Medicare Advantage plan matters most when it keeps routine care, prescriptions, and urgent needs affordable and predictable.
